This gives you 300 stages total, with plenty of variety so the tower doesn't feel repetitive. You can also add seasonal updates (Halloween, Christmas, Easter, Summer) with new squishy-themed stages and collectibles to keep players coming back.

answers.ask: 300 stages will not fit one image. Do you want the five worlds built as five separate towers stacked in fiction, or one continuous spiral generated in passes?
answers.answer: Build the five worlds as five separate themed towers, progressing in order from Butter Land through the Ultimate Squishy Factory; this keeps each world distinct and manageable.

answers.ask: Is each world its own tower with a teleporter between them, or does one tower run all the way up?
answers.answer: Each world is its own tower, with a teleporter at the completed tower’s top leading to the next world.

config.genre_evidence: "250+ Stages," "Butter stick jumps," "balance beams," "parkour," "safe timing obstacles," and five separate themed towers progressed through by teleporters all describe a staged obstacle-course and tower-climbing layout.
config.evidence: “five separate themed towers” and “a teleporter at the completed tower’s top leading to the next world” explicitly establish tower ascent; “Giant presses (safe timing obstacles)” supports timed obstacles.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Obby & Platformer map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Tower / Spiral Ascent: A course wrapping or stacking so platforms sit directly above each other.

INCLUDE:
- Sequential Platform Track: A chain of platforms spaced to the physics limits above — the ordered route through the course.
- Timed Obstacles: Platforms that vanish after being stepped on, or a set time after activation.
- Climb Obstacles: Trusses, ladders, tightropes, and wall scrambles.
- End Reward Area: A distinct reward area at the end of the course holding the payoff items.
